name: Swift Feather
notes: Swift Feather: the player walks 5% faster, up to 4 times (+20%). Adds 1 to boost_speed (each point +5%: the player's topdown_controller speed_step). Offered on the waves mode's level-up menu (menu_power); its level is kept in 'up_speed' (back to 0 each run).
title: SWIFT FEATHER
